desc: Ideation: deepest-valid-trie-node formulation with off-path (count >= k) and on-path (count >= k+1) cases
Implement the complete trie-based solution: construction, per-depth good counts, iterative DFS with off-path heap/on-path stack tracking, terminal answer assignment, and the `n - 1 < k` early return

Verify correctness on the two provided examples plus randomized brute-force comparison on small inputs (3000 trials vs exhaustive combinations, 500 medium + 100 long-word trials vs sorted-window brute force)
Test edge cases: duplicates, words that are prefixes of others, `k=1`, `k=n`, branching side paths, disjoint word groups, and deep shared prefixes — all covered and passing
Complexity/performance check: O(L + N log N) time, O(N) memory, iterative DFS handles depth up to 1e4 within the 1e5 total-length constraint
